title: Weapon Chaos
description: Every launch rolls a weapon, health, movement and weapon modifier package before the match starts.

title: Unholy Trinity
description: Rocket Launcher + Lightning Gun + Railgun. Infinite ammo, no weapon/ammo pickups, fast weapon switching.

title: Hot Rockets
description: Rocket-only arena: heavy direct/splash damage, fast reload, infinite ammo and reduced interruption from pickups.

title: Rocket Mayhem
description: Fast rockets, huge splash/knockback, low gravity and faster movement. Deliberately chaotic.

title: All Guns FFA
description: Spawn fully armed with infinite ammo and fight immediately; no weapon or ammo control required.

title: Knockout
description: High knockback, low weapon damage and space-map friendly rules. Win by throwing opponents around as much as shooting them.

title: Turbo Quake
description: Faster movement, stronger air control, bunny-hop physics and near-instant weapon switching.

title: Glass Cannon
description: Full arsenal, only 50 health and no starting armor. Very fast, punishing fights.

title: Juggernaut Arena
description: Full arsenal, 400 health + 200 armor, infinite ammo and sustained fights.

title: Aim Arena
description: Compact all-weapon aim fights: 200 health, 100 armor, full loadout, infinite ammo and no pickups.

title: Vampire FFA
description: Damage heals the attacker. Keep fighting to stay alive.

title: Regenerator
description: Health and armor regenerate during combat. Long fights and aggressive recovery.

title: Plasma Storm
description: Very fast plasma, faster fire rate, expanded splash and infinite ammo.

title: Rail Frenzy
description: Rail-only, fast reload, lower per-shot damage and high knockback: aim fast rather than wait for one-shot kills.

title: Excessive Lite
description: A restrained excessive-style preset: faster weapons, stronger projectiles, higher speed and full arsenal.
